newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close at new record as Wall Street soars.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close at new record as Wall Street soars.

text.p: UK shares pushed further into record territory on Friday, closing higher for the fourth consecutive session and for the 13th time this year as Wall Street continued to defy gravity.

The FTSE 100 closed 21.0 points higher to 4,420.3, spurred on by a 50-point early jump by the Dow. The key UK index jumped 112 points, or 2.6 percent, during the week and has risen by 302 points, or 7.3 percent, so far this year.
"With the Dow now looking like it could set a new record, some people are taking the view that they'd better fill their boots," one senior dealer said.
